title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8855: AE2 26.1.7 alpha  Wireless Crafting Terminal voids items and doesn't work.

text: [issue by delolione] ### Describe the bug ATM11-AE2 26.1.7 alpha The wireless crafting terminal does not craft. The whole 3x3 crafting grid doesn't work. Not through jei or manually. Anything added to the grid will be voided. ### How to reproduce the bug Open wireless crafting terminal, try putting any items in the crafting grid. ### Expected behavior Should craft items and not void things. ### Additional details _No response_ ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log There was no crash [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] It works fine in my dev enviroment though. Perhaps you need to be more specific about what you are doing step by step. What exactly does "voided" mean? You place the item into the Crafting Grid and it is gone instantly? In my test I did the following: 1. Build a test AE2 setup with at least a Wireless Access Point, a ME Drive with an Item Storage Cell 2. Put some Copper Ingots in 3. Link a Wireless Crafting Terminal to the Access Point and verify that it can see the Copper Ingots. 4. Open the Wireless Crafting Terminal 5. Put Copper Ingot from the AE2 system into the Crafting Terminal area 6. Craft some Copper Nuggets and put them into the AE2 system. [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] In ATM11 (with a manual upgrade to the latest 26.1.7-alpha of AE2) I can reproduce this behavior with some tricks: - It only affects the Wireless Crafting Terminal, not a Crafting Terminal (the part stationary on a cable). - It only happens, when the Wireless Crafting Terminal is in a curio slot (and opened via hotkey). - If the Wireless Crafting Terminal has items in its grid before being placed in a curio slot, you cannot remove the content of the grid. My first intuition is that the curio integration has a problem, e.g. that it cannot change the item in the curio slot (content of the grid is afaik saved as some data on the item). With this insight I can reproduce it in my dev environment as well. (Set `runtime_curio` to `true`, actually add some curio slots by placing a file in this location: `src/main/resources/data/ae2/curios/player.json` with the following content: ``` { "entities": ["player"], "slots": ["head", "back"] } ``` As a workaround for now you could keep your Wireless Crafting Terminal in the regular player inventory or on the hotbar. [comment by Mari023 (collaborator)] I think what happens here is that previously, the stack in the `itemHandler` could be modified directly, and the change would get reflected in the curios slot. However with the change to `resourceHandler`, we only get a copy of the item, we'll have to set the item too whenever we change anything. [comment by delolione (none)] > In ATM11 (with a manual upgrade to the latest 26.1.7-alpha of AE2) I can reproduce this behavior with some tricks: > > * It only affects the Wireless Crafting Terminal, not a Crafting Terminal (the part stationary on a cable). > * It only happens, when the Wireless Crafting Terminal is in a curio slot (and opened via hotkey). > * If the Wireless Crafting Terminal has items in its grid before being placed in a curio slot, you cannot remove the content of the grid. > > My first intuition is that the curio integration has a problem, e.g. that it cannot change the item in the curio slot (content of the grid is afaik saved as some data on the item). > > With this insight I can reproduce it in my dev environment as well. (Set `runtime_curio` to `true`, actually add some curio slots by placing a file in this location: `src/main/resources/data/ae2/curios/player.json` with the following content: > > ``` > { > "entities": ["player"], > "slots": ["head", "back"] > } > ``` > > As a workaround for now you could keep your Wireless Crafting Terminal in the regular player inventory or on the hotbar. Correct, it is in my Curio slot and I am opening it by hotkey. My apologies but I did not realize such a detail mattered. I am glad to know you were able to reproduce it though. Thank you. **Additionally,** when the wireless terminal (not crafting) is opened the same way, it does not retain any settings for "sort by" or "sort order". Open wireless terminal (not crafting) while it is in curio slot, using hotkey. Change "sort by" and "sort order". Close Terminal Open Terminal Settings will be reverted. This does NOT happen when using the terminal normally from the hotbar. [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] > Additionally, when the wireless terminal (not crafting) is opened the same way, it does not retain any settings for "sort by" or "sort order". This is most likely just another symptom of the same problem. I think we have understood **why** it happens, but I've no idea how to fix it right now. [comment by nikkisaurus (none)] > As a workaround for now you could keep your Wireless Crafting Terminal in the regular player inventory or on the hotbar. Just curious, is it still safe to us the hotkey with it in the inventory/hotbar, or do we need to only open it by right clicking? [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] The hotkey in the inventory or the hotbar should be safe. Can't test it right now. The problem is the curio slot. Just try using the hotkey with the terminal in the inventory. Put something you don't mind losing into the 3x3 crafting grid. If it does not disappear immediately, it is safe. Unfortunately a proper fix needs a large rewrite or so I've heard. [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] I just tested it in ATM11. Using the hotkey while holding the Wireless Crafting Terminal anywhere in the player inventory or the hotbar is safe. Just don't put it in a curio slot and you are fine. [comment by jerryjjr (none)] Seems related to this issue, still present in ATM11 - Applied Energistics 2 - 26.1.10 beta Magnet card stops working when placing wireless crafting terminal in curios slot. Works like normal anywhere in inventory.
